Title:
Civil Drafter
Shape Melbourne’s Future with KBR
 
KBR is the Principal Design Partner on the North Western Program Alliance (NWPA), alongside LXRP, Metro Trains Melbourne, and John Holland. 
Since 2017, NWPA has delivered ~$3B in transport infrastructure and now has a secured pipeline through to 2027. Current works include Melbourne Airport Rail, level crossing removals, and major bridge projects. 
KBR is part of the SRL East Linewide Alliance, delivering a transformative 90km orbital rail network across Melbourne. 
SRL East includes 26km of tunnels and six new stations, supporting connected communities and future growth. 
As part of the alliance, KBR (with WSP) leads multi-disciplinary design and systems integration across track, civil, structures, power, and rail systems. 
The Opportunity
 
We are seeking a Civil Drafter to join our growing team supporting NWPA and/or SRL projects. Reporting to the Team Leader, you will contribute to the delivery of a variety of Transport infrastructure projects.
You will be responsible for producing high-quality civil design documentation using Bentley MicroStation while working closely with civil designers, engineers, project managers and other drafters.
Who are you?
 
You are a motivated Civil Drafter with at least 3 years’ experience in Civil infrastructure projects and a strong understanding of drafting standards and best practices. You enjoy working collaboratively and take pride in delivering accurate, high quality drawings.
You will also have the following skills and experience: 
Associate Diploma in Civil Engineering design/drafting or equivalent relevant qualification 
3+ years’ civil drafting experience, preferably within transport infrastructure projects.
Proficiency in Bentley Microstation
Experience with Bentley OpenRoads Designer (desirable).
Strong knowledge of civil drafting standards and documentation requirements.
Ability to prepare drafting deliverables across all project stages.
Strong coordination and communications skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, project managers, and other drafters.
A practical, proactive approach combined with a commitment to continuous improvement and innovation.
At KBR, We Value You
 
Our values define how we operate and how we support our people: 
We Value Our People, We Deliver, We Are People of Integrity, We Empower, and We Are a Team of Teams.
 
As you focus on leading high‑impact engineering solutions, we ensure you have the support, flexibility, and autonomy you need to thrive. Enjoy hybrid working options, family‑friendly arrangements, and a culture built on trust, empowerment, and collaboration. 
At KBR, you’ll work alongside some of the industry’s most respected experts with the support of a global organisation—and the connected, supportive feel of a local team. Here, you’re not just part of the business; you’re integral to shaping its future. 
KBR values an inclusive and diverse work environment, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Our hiring decisions are based on the key requirements of each role and candidates are selected based on their unique strengths and experiences.
